statement.text:
Classify the locally finite groups for which the augmentation ideal of the
complex group algebra is a simple ring. The problem goes back to I. Kaplansky
(1965). For partial results, see (K. Bonvallet, B. Hartley, D. S. Passman, M. K. Smith,
Proc. Amer. Math. Soc., 56, no. 1 (1976), 79–82; A. E. Zalesskiı̆, Algebra i Analiz,
2, no. 6 (1990), 132–149 (Russian); Ch. Praeger, A. E. Zalesskii, Proc. London Math.
Soc., 70, no. 2 (1995), 313–335; B. Hartley, A. Zalesski, J. London Math. Soc., 55
(1997), 210–230).                                                        A. E. Zalesskiı̆
